title: Reviewer type
description: Pick exactly one; there is no automatic fallback. chat uses the DSH LLM service; decision calls a Clef / Jev compatible REST backend directly.
failureDescription: When the backend is unavailable, times out or returns invalid output the call enters error-escalate: it is not auto-approved and the backend is not switched. The decision 11-level criteria are built into the plugin.
apiKeyHint: Only the reference name is stored here, never the secret value.
noCredentials: This composition has no credentials service
repairHint: Only JSON / schema / contradiction errors are retried; provider errors are not.

model.label: Model
model.hint: Choosing "follow the session model" uses the model of the session that made this call; the concrete model is still saved as provider / model.
model.searchPlaceholder: Filter by provider or model name
model.failed: Reading the model catalog failed; the saved selection is kept and saving is unaffected.
model.unsupported: This composition has no LLM service, so host models cannot be listed.
model.empty: The host has no models configured yet; you can keep "follow the session model".
model.notInCatalog: The current selection is not in the host catalog; the saved provider / model is still used.
model.providerFailed: Reading the model list for {provider} failed.
model.filteredOut: The current selection is hidden by the search filter; the original provider / model is kept.

test.title: Reviewer connection test
test.sessionDisabled: The test needs a concrete model; choose one and test again.
test.costNotice: The test sends a model request and may incur cost.
test.passedFirst: Passed: the first response already matched the output contract.
test.passedRepaired: Passed: matched the output contract after {count} format repairs.
test.details: Show the input, each response and the error
test.requestFailed: The request failed: cannot read the test response.

failure.modelRequired: A concrete model must be selected
failure.credentialMissing: The credential is not configured or cannot be resolved
failure.invalidOutput: The output does not match the contract
failure.unknown: Cause undetermined; see the material below
